# Fictional behaviour sheet: Anna, a client

Anna is anxious and answers in short sentences. She mentions her medication only when she is asked about it.
She says that she has missed her last two appointments only when she is asked about appointments.
She does not mention her allergy to penicillin unless she is asked directly about allergies.
